title: Albanian Student Protests Turn Violent Amid Growing Anger
subtitle: Thousands of students take to the streets in Tirana to demand better education and an end to government corruption.

summary.en: Tens of thousands of students have protested in Albania's capital, leading to violent clashes with police. Demonstrators are angry about high education costs, poor university conditions, and government corruption. The protests resulted in fires at a government building and local banks. While the government has condemned the violence, the European Union has called for an investigation into police actions. This unrest follows a summer of peaceful protests and is part of a wider wave of student activism across Europe.
summary.zh: 數以萬計的學生在阿爾巴尼亞首都發起抗議，導致與警方發生暴力衝突。示威者對高昂的教育成本、惡劣的大學環境以及政府貪腐感到憤怒。抗議活動導致政府大樓與當地銀行遭縱火。儘管政府譴責暴力，歐盟仍呼籲對警方行為進行調查。此次動盪發生在夏季和平抗議之後，也是歐洲各地學生運動浪潮的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Tens of thousands of students marched through the streets of Tirana, the capital of Albania, this week in a major protest that turned violent. The demonstrators, who are calling for better conditions at universities and lower education costs, set fire to the ministry of education building and two local banks. The situation quickly became dangerous as protesters threw stones at police, who responded by using water cannons and teargas to control the crowds.
paragraphs.zh: 本週，數以萬計的學生在阿爾巴尼亞首都地拉那（Tirana）街頭遊行，爆發了嚴重的抗議活動。示威者要求改善大學環境並降低教育成本，他們放火焚燒了教育部大樓及兩間當地銀行。隨著抗議者向警方投擲石塊，局勢迅速惡化，警方則以水砲和催淚瓦斯進行反制以控制群眾。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, these protests are the most violent response yet against Prime Minister Edi Rama. While Rama won a fourth term in office last year, he has faced increasing criticism regarding corruption among top officials. Students expressed their frustration with the current political situation, with some protesters calling for the Prime Minister to resign. Many students also stated that they are tired of peaceful methods and want to see real change in their education system, including better financial support and more job opportunities after they graduate.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，這些抗議活動是針對總理艾迪·拉瑪（Edi Rama）迄今最激烈的反彈。儘管拉瑪去年贏得第四個任期，但他因高層官員貪腐問題面臨越來越多的批評。學生們表達了對當前政治局勢的挫折感，部分示威者要求總理下台。許多學生也表示，他們已厭倦了和平手段，希望看到教育體系出現實質改變，包括獲得更好的經濟補助，以及畢業後有更多就業機會。

paragraphs.en: This recent unrest follows a summer of peaceful protests in Albania. Earlier this year, citizens gathered to speak out against a proposed luxury resort project on the southern coast. That project, which is connected to Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of Donald Trump, has faced several legal challenges. Many protesters feel that the government is not listening to their concerns, and they are now using these larger demonstrations to demand that their voices be heard.
paragraphs.zh: 這波近期的動盪發生在阿爾巴尼亞經歷了一個夏季的和平抗議之後。今年稍早，民眾曾聚集起來，反對一項在南部海岸興建豪華度假村的提案。該計畫與川普（Donald Trump）的女婿傑瑞德·庫許納（Jared Kushner）有關，並已面臨多項法律挑戰。許多抗議者認為政府並未傾聽他們的擔憂，因此現在透過這些規模更大的示威活動，要求政府聽取他們的聲音。

paragraphs.en: Government officials have strongly criticized the violence. Albana Koçiu, the deputy prime minister, wrote on Facebook that while protesting is a right, it should not be used as an excuse for destroying property or fighting in the streets. She urged citizens to stay away from acts of vandalism. The police also released a statement, warning that anyone who destroys property or attacks officers will be held responsible for their actions under the law.
paragraphs.zh: 政府官員強烈譴責暴力行為。副總理阿巴娜·柯丘（Albana Koçiu）在臉書上寫道，雖然抗議是權利，但不應成為破壞財產或街頭鬥毆的藉口。她呼籲民眾遠離破壞公物的行為。警方也發布聲明警告，任何破壞財產或攻擊員警的人，都將依法追究責任。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, the European Union (EU)—a group of countries that Albania hopes to join—has expressed concern about the situation. The EU delegation in Tirana stated that they are worried about the "violent escalation" of the protests. They also noted reports of excessive force used by the police against both protesters and journalists. The EU has called for a quick investigation into these events and encouraged all sides to lower the tension to avoid further conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，阿爾巴尼亞希望加入的歐洲聯盟（EU）也對此局勢表達擔憂。歐盟駐地拉那代表團表示，他們對抗議活動的「暴力升級」感到憂心。他們也注意到有報導指出，警方對抗議者和記者使用了過度武力。歐盟呼籲針對這些事件進行迅速調查，並鼓勵各方降低緊張局勢，以避免進一步衝突。

paragraphs.en: These events in Albania are part of a larger movement of student activism across Europe. Similar protests have been happening in France, where students have been marching for weeks. In France, demonstrators are demanding more teachers, smaller class sizes, and repairs to school buildings that are falling apart. Students in both countries argue that poor conditions and a lack of investment are making it very difficult for them to get a good education.
paragraphs.zh: 阿爾巴尼亞發生的這些事件，是歐洲各地學生運動浪潮的一部分。法國也出現了類似的抗議活動，學生們已經連續數週走上街頭。在法國，示威者要求增加教師人數、縮小班級規模，並修繕日益破敗的校舍。兩國的學生皆主張，惡劣的環境與缺乏投資，使他們難以獲得良好的教育。

paragraphs.en: As the protests in Albania continue, they have already spread beyond the capital to other cities, including Elbasan and Shkodër. For many students, the issue is not just about the cost of school, but about their future in a country where they feel ignored by those in power. With the government demanding order and the students refusing to stop their protests, the situation remains tense. It is unclear how the government will respond to these demands, but it is clear that the students are determined to keep fighting for the changes they believe are necessary for their future.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著阿爾巴尼亞的抗議活動持續進行，示威已從首都蔓延至艾巴申（Elbasan）和斯庫台（Shkodër）等其他城市。對許多學生而言，問題不僅在於學費成本，更在於他們在一個感覺被當權者忽視的國家中，對未來感到迷惘。在政府要求恢復秩序、學生拒絕停止抗議的情況下，局勢依然緊繃。目前尚不清楚政府將如何回應這些訴求，但顯而易見的是，學生們決心繼續爭取他們認為對未來至關重要的改變。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To express your opinion publicly, especially when you are protesting against something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 公開發表意見（尤指反對某事時）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見動詞 speak 後接介系詞，這裡指公開表達立場。文中：Earlier this year, citizens gathered to speak out against a proposed luxury resort project on the southern coast.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be in very bad condition and needing repairs.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是「掉落分開」，這裡形容建築物年久失修。文中：In France, demonstrators are demanding more teachers, smaller class sizes, and repairs to school buildings that are falling apart.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be blamed or punished for something that has happened.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 被追究責任、被視為應負責。

quiz.question: Which specific buildings were damaged by protesters during the recent demonstrations in Tirana?

options.A: The Prime Minister's office and the local police station
options.B: The ministry of education building and two local banks
options.C: The luxury resort project office and the ministry of education
options.D: The national parliament building and several local banks

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確提到示威者縱火燒毀了「the ministry of education building and two local banks」。選項 A 提到總理辦公室，文中未提及；選項 C 提到的度假村辦公室與第三段的度假村爭議有關，但非縱火目標；選項 D 提到的國會大廈並未在縱火清單中，屬於錯誤資訊。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between the Albanian government and its citizens based on the text?

options.A: The government has successfully addressed all student concerns regarding education costs.
options.B: Citizens feel that the government is responsive to their needs regarding environmental issues.
options.C: There is a growing sense of alienation and distrust between the public and the current administration.
options.D: The government and the protesters are currently working together to draft new education policies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段提到學生對政治現狀感到挫折，以及第三段明確指出「Many protesters feel that the government is not listening to their concerns」，顯示民眾與政府間存在嚴重的溝通斷層與不信任感。選項 A 與事實相反；選項 B 錯誤，因為民眾對度假村計畫的不滿證明他們認為政府不理會環境訴求；選項 D 則完全未發生，雙方目前處於對立狀態。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the phrase 'violent escalation' mean in the context of the EU's statement?

options.A: A rapid increase in the intensity and severity of the conflict
options.B: A planned strategy to organize the protesters more effectively
options.C: The act of moving the protest to a higher physical location
options.D: A formal request for the police to use more advanced equipment

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第五段中，歐盟對抗議活動的「violent escalation」表示擔憂，結合上下文提到示威者縱火與警方使用水砲，可知此詞意指衝突變得越來越激烈且嚴重。選項 B 錯誤，escalation 指的是程度加劇而非組織策略；選項 C 是對該詞的字面誤解；選項 D 則與歐盟要求降低緊張局勢的立場完全背道而馳。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article?

options.A: The legal challenges surrounding a luxury resort project in southern Albania
options.B: A comparison between the education systems of France and Albania
options.C: The history of political corruption under Prime Minister Edi Rama
options.D: The growing student-led unrest in Albania driven by dissatisfaction with the government and living conditions

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章的核心在於報導阿爾巴尼亞學生抗議活動的升級，探討其背後的動機（教育成本、對政府的不滿）以及該事件的廣泛影響。選項 A 僅是背景資訊之一；選項 B 僅在第六段提到，並非全文主旨；選項 C 雖有提及，但只是學生不滿的原因之一，而非文章探討的整體事件焦點。
